summary: Andreatta–Goren–Howard–Madapusi Pera prove the averaged Colmez conjecture (Theorem A) by computing the arithmetic intersection of Borcherds divisors with a big CM cycle on GSpin Shimura varieties (Theorem B), including the ramified and dyadic local deformation calculations, and comparing the metrized Hodge bundles with Faltings heights of CM abelian varieties through the total reflex algebra. Complete (cc-442dc5): every numbered statement is an item, every missing item is routed exactly once, and twenty-seven findings are recorded. Lemma 9.4.4, Proposition 9.4.5 and Lemma 9.4.3 are false as printed (E1–E3), and the corrected BKY12 formula is E26; none affects Theorems A or B. Not formalised.

conventions.global: E/F is a CM quadratic extension, [F:Q]=d, with maximal order OE, canonical conjugation c and fixed distinguished complex embedding iota0. Unless explicitly reduced to the classical d=1 case, the orthogonal argument assumes d>1. L is a maximal integral lattice in V=TrF/Q(E,ξ Nm), ξ negative at iota0 and positive at every other real place.
conventions.degree: deg_C(Y)=sum over E-stack Y(C) of 1/|Aut(y)|, not the degree over Z. Y_infinity(C), viewed as a Z-stack, has weighted size 2d deg_C(Y). Arithmetic degrees have finite etale-local lengths log N(q)/|Aut| and one-half of the archimedean sum.
conventions.analytic: L(s,χ) is the finite Hecke L-function. Λ(s,χ)=(D_E/D_F)^(s/2) Γ_R(s+1)^d L(s,χ), Γ_R(s)=π^(−s/2)Γ(s/2). Λ(s)=Λ(1−s). log-derivative at0 is L'/L(0)+1/2 log(D_E/D_F)−d/2 log(4πe^γ).
conventions.local: At nonsplit p of F above rational p, q is the unique E-prime, valuations v_p and v_q give their own uniformizers value1. m=v_p(d_F/Qp), n=v_q(d_E/F)=v_p(D_E/F), f=m+n. Never identify these normalized valuations in the ramified case. Haar measure is self-dual for the chosen additive character; retain both Weil indices when taking nearby ratios.
conventions.badPrimes: a≈_L b means a−b lies in the Q-span of log p for rational p|D_bad,L. This is not equality modulo all bad primes of the enlarged lattice, nor an exact real equality.

summaryBefore: The paper proves the averaged Colmez formula for maximal-order CM abelian varieties by evaluating arithmetic intersections of special divisors with a big CM cycle on GSpin integral models, including ramified and dyadic local deformation calculations. The finite-L normalization includes −d log(2π)/2. This extraction routes the local lifting package to the existing Lubin–Tate proposal, integral orthogonal geometry to the existing Kuga–Satake proposal, the big-CM intersection package to the existing GSpin divisor-height proposal, and total-reflex/height comparison to the existing CM Part II. Several printed local-length, metric, lattice and Whittaker formulas require correction or further source-level verification; no claim of disproof of the averaged Colmez theorem is made.
